### 1. Request, simulator mode
Simulator (Marisol Quintanilla) states: "you want to pay off the rest of Lucia's Pre-K tuition for the school year in one payment today ... tell you the exact amount, because you will make the payment yourself in the district's online parent portal, from my checking account"; "you do not want to use a card". Identity: name, phone 5125550183, DL last4 5517, DOB 1990-04-22. She conveys facts only conditionally ("Only if the person asks about Lucia's after-school care ... Workforce Solutions helps pay for it"; "Only if they ask about November and December ... paid October with a personal check"), agrees to postings ("you tell them to go ahead and do it"), and runs the handed-over portal tool with "exactly the amount they gave" by "checking account (a bank draft)". Passive persona; she executes one user tool at the agent's direction.

### 2. Act / wait / refuse
Act now. Visible grounds: prek_tuition_advance_payment_portal "A family may pay the rest of the school year's Pre-K tuition in advance in one payment, which the parent or guardian makes personally in the district's online payment portal"; enrollment is "Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based)", status "enrolled", school year 2026-27. Payment method: portal "takes online card and ACH bank draft payments" → `ach_bank_draft` (checking account by bank draft). Verification first: verify_household_identity "must pass before any account details are discussed"; phone 5125550183 + id_last4 5517 (2 matches).

Household 423d020d-…; student Lucia acf26c68-… (450517); enrollment 4a6eaf93-fcf8-4ce5-b01a-e3bb7b562bce (PK4, Pre-K Tuition-Based, enrolled, registration 2026-07-13, entry 2026-08-12). Ledger: tuition charges 498.00 for 2026-08 (posted 07-13), 09, 10, 11, 12 (posted on the 1st; Dec charge d1b82598-5676-47ec-8881-3a6cc5238e2d); late fees 40.00 (2026-10, posted 10-06) and 55.00 (2026-11, posted 11-06); payments 498.00 online_card 07-15, 498.00 ach_bank_draft 09-04, 538.00 personal_check 10-08; no credits. ### 4. Scored parameters
Most recent billing month = 2026-12 ("the latest billing month that carries a tuition charge").

(a) Late fee for 2026-12, assessed 2026-12-17 (prek_tuition_late_fee_assessment + prek_late_fee_amount_and_billing_month): due day 12-05 (charge posted 12-01, not after day 5); offset 1 day (fee schedule "Calendar days after the due day on which the late fee posts | 1"); 12 days ≥ 1; month carries no late fee; open balance 2,490.00 + 95.00 − 1,534.00 = 1,051.00; unpaid part = lesser(498.00, 1,051.00) = 498.00 > 0 → owed. Baseline fee 25.00 (fee schedule). Tiers: repeat_late_fee_schedule — already carries two (Oct, Nov) → 35.00 in place; unpaid_month_late_fee_addition — whole charge unpaid → +15.00; paper_payment_handling_charge — one personal_check (10-08) → +10.00; multi_program_household_late_fee_reduction — two active Creek Kids Club enrollments (Lucia, Mateo) → −5.00; yearly_late_fee_cap — 95.00 already posted → limit 55.00. Order (step 6): place/additions 35+15+10 = 60.00 → limit 55.00 → −5.00 → **50.00**, billing_month "2026-12".

(b) Combined-program credit against the Dec charge d1b82598 (combined_program_credit_amount): baseline 40.00. Tiers: wraparound_seat_funding_credit_rates — seat subsidy payer Workforce Solutions → 20.00 in place of 40.00; wraparound_start_month_credit_share — start 12-16, in the billing month on/after the 16th → half (multiplier); wraparound_early_registration_credit — registered 12-09, 7 days before start → +5.00; creek_kids_club_household_size_credit_addition — two active → +10.00; combined_prek_and_wraparound_tuition_cap — Pre-K 498.00 + family's charge for the funded seat 192.00 − 0.00 remittances = 690.00 > 650.00 → +40.00; tuition_account_standing_credit_reduction — arrears (2,490 + 95 [+50 if fee posted first] − 1,534)/498 = 2.11 (2.21) → 2 → −7.50. Order (step 5): 20.00 → ×½ = 10.00 → +5 +10 +40 −7.50 = 57.50 → limit 498.00 → **57.50**. The order of (a) and (b) does not change either figure (arrears floor 2 both ways; the unpaid part stays 498.00 both ways).

(c) Advance payment, paid 2026-12-17 (advance_payment_amount_for_remaining_months): open balance after (a),(b) = 2,490.00 + 145.00 − 1,534.00 − 57.50 = 1,043.50; months not yet posted 10 − 5 = 5, priced 5 × 498.00 = 2,490.00; discount: pay_in_full_offer_discount — 5 or more months → half of one month 249.00 in place of the 3 % standard (74.70); advance_payment_discount_timing — due day 12-05, paid 12 days after → at half (multiplier) → 124.50; advance_payment_arrears_reduction — (2,635.00 − 1,534.00)/498 = 2.21 → 2 → −10.00 → 114.50; advance_payment_creek_kids_household_reduction — two active Creek Kids Club enrollments → −10.00 off the advance payment. Result 1,043.50 + 2,490.00 − 114.50 − 10.00 = **3,409.00**, payment_method `ach_bank_draft`, enrollment 4a6eaf93-….

Fall-back answer (computation document plus fee schedule only, writes (a),(b) made at baseline 25.00 and 40.00): open 2,490 + 120 − 1,534 − 40 = 1,036.00; + 2,490.00 − 74.70 = 3,451.30 (with factored writes but baseline advance: 1,043.50 + 2,490.00 − 74.70 = 3,458.80). Both definite and different from 3,409.00.

Factor findability (record words → document): "Late fees" rows Oct/Nov on the same enrollment → "Board-Approved Schedule of Repeat Pre-K Tuition Late Fees" / "Yearly Cap"; payment_method "personal_check" on a tuition payment → "Paper Payment Handling Charge on Pre-K Tuition Late Fees"; Creek Kids Club enrollments status active (care product, two children) → "Late Fee Reduction for Households with Several Children in Creek Kids Club", "Combined-Program Credit Addition for Households…", "Advance-Payment Reduction for Households…"; seat subsidy_payer workforce_solutions_ccs → "Combined-Program Credit Rates by How the Wraparound Seat Is Paid" and the cap's funded-seat row; seat start_date / registration_date → "Combined-Program Credit in the Month a Wraparound Seat Starts", "Early Registration Schedule for Pre-K Wraparound Seats"; tuition owed vs payments → the three Account-Standing schedules and the Unpaid-Month schedule; five posted months → Pay-in-Full Offer; payment date vs due day → Timing Rule. ### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
Root P0 = advance payment (customer's own tool). Its hub states: "The advance payment is not fixed until the late fee owed for the enrollment's most recent billing month, when that month's tuition was left unpaid after its due day, has been assessed. The advance payment is fixed only after the combined-program credit owed on the most recent billing month has been worked out and posted for a child who attends Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days)."
- Hop P0 ← P1 (late fee for 2026-12): state = "the late fee owed for the most recent billing month … has been assessed". Records: Dec charge 498.00 posted 12-01, no Dec late fee row, payments cover only through Oct+fee → Dec unpaid after 12-05. The write that brings it about is in "Pre-K Tuition Late Fees: Due Dates and Assessment at the Family Services Desk" ("one late fee for that billing month is assessed by the Family Services desk … Posting the fee"). **state-derived**.
- Hop P0 ← P2 (combined-program credit for 2026-12): state = "the combined-program credit owed on the most recent billing month has been worked out and posted"; records: Lucia holds an active Pre-K Wraparound seat; no credit row on the Dec charge. The write is in "Combined-Program Credit for Pre-K Children in Wraparound Care" ("is owed a combined-program credit against the tuition charged for each billing month in which the child holds that seat … Posting the credit"). **state-derived**.
- P1 and P2 hubs carry no prerequisite sentence; nothing further. Order: P1, P2 (any order) → P0.
Counter-proofs: "only quote the advance" is excluded by the hub's own two sentences and by the rules of P1 ("When part of a month's tuition is still unpaid after the due day, one late fee … is assessed") and P2 ("is owed a combined-program credit"). Closest alternatives: card payment (excluded: caller refuses card; ach_bank_draft is the checking-account value); standard 3 % discount (excluded by "5 or more … in place of the standard discount"); full discount (excluded by Timing Rule, 12 days after due day); family-paid seat rates 25/40 (excluded by subsidy payer); counting the Workforce Solutions seat at the family charge net of remittances — none posted, so 192.00; household meal-account factors do not apply to this policy (they modify the basis-month credit / reversal / waiver / plan, not the advance). Card/bank details never taken by staff (portal hub).
